comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh full-restart verification on27October2026. Adopted TiSEM EER2026–2027v4 pp65–67 fixes the English BSc E&BI2026-entry pathway across2026–2029:180EC,60peryear. All named first/second-year courses compulsory;year3 includes30ECapproved mobility/minor/internship space,6ECPhilosophyforBusiness,12ECGraduationProject,one6ECspecialisation andone6ECprogramme elective. Restricted choices are instantiated independently of UCR fit by formal EER list order:AdvancedStartupEntrepreneurship andInternationalEntrepreneurship. These are course choices,not an invented formal route. GROW0EC is explicitly noncompulsory and highly recommended in every semester. EER3.7 governs elective approval/nonoverlap;4.4–4.7 and5.6 govern progression,project/internship eligibility,manual requirements and assessed-practical attendance conditions. Formal E&BI learning outcomes onp65 also substantiate entrepreneurial research synthesis and presentation;the affected programme-interest row links that adopted source explicitly.

alternatives.labelRationale: The reconstructed programme retains venture/product development, marketing, market research, business law, negotiation, leadership, accounting and strategy. Its programming, mathematics, database and AI-ethics strand implements the explicit data/AI learning line without allowing algorithms and deep learning to displace too much business substance.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Six courses differ from the broad option(45EC):programming,mathematicalmethods,linearalgebra,probability/statistics,database systems andAIethics. These tools alter the mode of business analysis while direct venture/product/strategy/market work remains central; the option does not reproduce a formal Tilburg corporate specialisation.

alternatives.concept: Impact-oriented ventures combine customer-focused product design, business strategy, finance, marketing and leadership with climate, life-cycle assessment and circular-economy study. Environmental science, governance and sector cases define problems and interventions; business and research courses support decisions about viable and responsible ventures.

progressionAssessment.rationale: Revalidated on 31 October 2026 against the current workbook: all 24 assigned offerings are planned, every formal prerequisite is completed earlier, and PPD remains in Year 1. Introductory Economics is placed in Fall 2026, its only planned offering in this horizon. Business and research gateways precede dependent law, negotiation, marketing, organisational psychology and econometrics. Data Science precedes Machine Learning. Consumer Product Design has no formal prerequisite and remains a project-based application in the final semester.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Broad venture/businessinnovation first tested against defining target substance. Corporateinnovation/dataAI is the strongest additional official direction;its implementation is reconstructed to restore businesslaw,productdesign,econometrics and leadershipcommunication while dropping excess algorithms/deeplearning/generalpsychology. Sixcourse45ECdifference remains meaningful. Impactventures then passes with life-cycle/circular-economy and environmental intervention substance plus substantial businesscore;data andfinance replace weaker courseweight. All three concepts are independently evidenced and pairwise distinct;the maximum is reached after these sequential tests,not used as a target.

notes.text: Tilburg requires four successive Entrepreneurship in Action projects, dedicated startup/corporate/impact courses, a chosen advanced specialisation and a 12-EC graduation project. UCR provides substantive venture creation, product development, business and analytical study, with digital or impact directions, while retaining gaps in that specialist sequence.

audience.programmeDescription: Entrepreneurship and Business Innovation at Tilburg University studies how new ventures and existing organisations develop ideas into economic and societal value. Business theory, quantitative methods, programming and personal development support four Entrepreneurship in Action projects and a graduation project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The broad UCR option combines venture and product development with marketing, economics, leadership, financial study and research. The corporate option adds programming and quantitative business analytics; the impact option adds life-cycle assessment, sustainability and environmental intervention study. These programmes leave gaps in Tilburg’s four-project practice sequence, dedicated entrepreneurship contexts, specialist entrepreneurial finance and compulsory graduation project.
